summary: TransAlta Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 14, 2026, disclosing that subsidiary TransAlta Centralia Generation LLC received a U.S. Department of Energy order mandating Centralia Unit 2 in Washington State remain available for operation an additional 90 days, until December 12, 2026. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or shareholder vote are involved. The order is a regulatory directive, not a transaction; the company states it will comply and coordinate with DOE and Washington state officials. Watch for grid-reliability and regulatory developments.
